In this module, you will learn a practical design process and use fabrication tools to help with laser cutting. Start with the learning path. Open the tools when a project needs them.

## Learning path

::: {.ter-path-grid}
::: {.ter-path-card}
### Culture & Land-Based Learning

Begin with place, seasonal observation, community knowledge, and respectful sources.

[Open Culture & Land-Based Learning](culture-land-based-learning/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 1. N.I.C.E. Design Process

Find a need. Show an idea. Test it. Improve it.

[Open the design process](design-process/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 2. Logo & Nameplate Design

Use Photopea to build readable nameplate text, trace a logo, and combine the final design.

[Open Logo Design](logo-design/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 3. Accessible Design

Make type, colour, images, screens, prints, and fabricated graphics easier to understand.

[Open Accessible Design](accessible-design/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 4. Laser Cutting

Apply the design process to a name tag, measured parts, stands, organizers, and assemblies.

[Open the laser-cutting pathway](03-laser-cutting/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Tool Organizer Gallery

Study finished examples, drawings, ergonomic spacing, and the route from measurements to a prototype.

[Open the gallery](tools/tool-organizer-gallery/index.qmd)
:::
:::

## Fabrication tools

These tools provide editable starting points for laser-cut projects.

<article class="ter-project-card">
<p class="ter-course-code">Make a plate</p>
<h3>Fabrication Plate Builder</h3>
<p>Create plates, rings, and repeated holder holes with measured spacing.</p>

</article>
<article class="ter-project-card">
<p class="ter-course-code">Add supports</p>

<p><a href="tools/leg-builder/index.qmd">Open the Leg &amp; Support Builder →</a></p>
</article>
<article class="ter-project-card">

</article>
